overview: Interactive hiking diary for the E5 Alpine crossing from Oberstdorf to Meran in August 2026. Features 12 stages with elevation profiles, info cards, and a password-protected photo/text journal.
features: Interactive elevation profiles for all 12 stages
Clickable stage overview with rustic Alpine design
Stage detail pages with date, route, stats, and accommodation info
Password-protected photo and text upload from mobile
Photo pinning on elevation profile points
Special markers for Summit Day (Stage 9) and Taxi transfer (Stage 3)
